top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one was behind with immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The carbon monoxide detector is not being tested monthly.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The hand washing sink in the infant classroom was observed being used to clean pacifiers as well as prepare bottles.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver who the director stated received orientation during hire did not have documentation of the verified orientation.    This was corrected during inspection with the director and caregiver signing completion of orientation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.
